vidljivost.title:
So that people
find you on Google.
vidljivost.lead: A beautiful site nobody can find is worth nothing. That is why every site we build goes out with the groundwork for visibility already in place — not as an add-on, but as part of the job.
vidljivost.i1: Technical foundations Titles, descriptions and structured data that Google reads, clean page addresses, a sitemap and fast loading. Without these, nothing else helps.
vidljivost.i2: Google Business Profile We set up and maintain the profile that puts you on the map and in local search — often a guest's very first contact with you.
vidljivost.i3: Copy written for search Content that answers what people actually type: the place, the type of accommodation, distance to the sea, parking, pets.
vidljivost.i4: Measurement Analytics and Search Console, so you can see where visitors come from and which searches bring bookings — instead of guessing.
